tagline: Your reading identity, earned one book at a time
category: Social Book Tracking & Gamified Reading Habit App
core_value_proposition: A clean, visually elegant platform that allows readers to track their progress, build a reading identity through milestone badges, and share reading updates with a community.
description: Millibro is a social reading platform — a place where readers track what they're reading, discover new books, and connect with other readers around their reading journeys. It brings the shared, book-club feel of talking about books with friends into an everyday app, rather than reading being something people do in isolation.

gamified_reading_identity.description: Color-coded progression system based on total books read
gamified_reading_identity.marketing_angle: Gamification that turns reading into a visual achievement system without cluttering the aesthetic

reading_progress_tracking.description: Active progress tracker with exact page counts, completion percentages, visual progress bars, and quick 'Add Progress' button

visual_bookshelf.description: Completed book covers displayed in a clean grid view (Books Read shelf)

social_feed.description: Micro-journaling feed where users post reading updates with likes, comments, and sharing

brand.color_palette: Soft cream/beige background, deep forest green primary accents, vibrant badge highlights
brand.typography: Classical serif headline font for literary feel + clean sans-serif UI text

target_audience: Book lovers, avid readers, book club members, literary community, reading habit builders, bookstagrammers, BookTok creators
unique_selling_points: Reading identity you earn and show off
Social without being noisy — thoughtful micro-journaling
Beautiful minimalist design that feels premium
Gamification that motivates without being gimmicky
